texts: On day 0 of Year 1, the night of the autumn equinox was clear and mild.
The moth-count at each lantern of the Cliff Path was about twenty-five.
A crowd of nightmoths gathered at the East Row.
Three sky-cats descended from the cliff-spires.
The three sky-cats hunted nightmoths at the East Row.
The nightmoth crowd at the East Row shrank.
The moth-count at the East Row was seven at the third watch.
Each nightmoth that survived the hunt fled to the Hollows.

q1_issues.issue: (Experiencer sk_moth_count_1 east_row) hangs a thematic role on sk_moth_count_1, which is typed as the entity moth_count rather than as a reified state, and lines 52-53 then put the eventuality-only Time and Past heads on that same non-eventuality.

The reified count witness carries the time (third_watch) but no value, while the value 7 sits in the separate flat (Past (Measure east_row moth_count 7 unspecified)) with no time, so 'seven at the third watch' is never joined.

S7 mints a moth_count entity while the parallel S2 clause ('the moth-count at each lantern ... was about twenty-five') encodes the same construction as a bare Measure on the location with no count entity, so one passage gets two incompatible encodings of one construction.

(Patient sk_hunt_1 sk_preymoths_1) - hunting does not create, destroy, consume or physically change its object, and the instruction set's tie-breaker ('when the test is unclear, default to Theme') points to Theme.

q2_gaps: A time adjunct on a measured value ('the moth-count ... was seven AT THE THIRD WATCH'): Measure has no Time slot, tense only wraps it, and the copular-with-time-modifier reification is defined for adjectival property states, so there is no licensed carrier for when a quantity held.
A day-index within a year ('on DAY 0 of Year 1'): the (Day <n>) term is the calendar day-of-month slot; a 'day N of Year Y' ordinal-day calendar has no defined encoding.
A passage-initial date frame ('On day 0 of Year 1, ...'): nothing states whether it scopes over the following sentences, so only the first clause ends up dated.
review.notes: Compound decomposition, the Cliff Path / East Row / Hollows name handling, the counted-group + per-member-rule pattern for the sky-cats, and the 'each nightmoth that survived' relative-clause universal all follow the instruction set closely. The one structurally broken block is S7's reified moth-count.

issues.reason: Thematic roles and the heads Past/Time are eventuality-only ((<Role> <event> <filler>), (<Status> <event>)), yet the parse's own (Member sk_moth_count_1 moth_count) + (Inheritance moth_count count) type that symbol as a count, so Experiencer/Time/Past on it are ill-typed — and 'at the East Row' is a locative restrictor, not the entity a state holds of.

Core patterns bars a stated qualifier from being dropped ('carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap'), but the only valued atom, (Past (Measure east_row moth_count 7 unspecified)), carries no time while (Time sk_moth_count_1 third_watch) sits on a disconnected symbol with no value, so 'seven at the third watch' is recorded nowhere.

The divergence is real and the extra reified block is the unlicensed half, but 'two incompatible encodings' overstates it — S7 also emits S2's (Measure <place> moth_count <n> unspecified) form, and minting a witness for the definite 'the moth-count at the East Row' is itself licensed (a definite description is a typed individual), so the defect is the eventuality heads hung on that witness, not the witness.

The object test is 'does the object itself change?' with the explicit tie-break 'when the test is unclear, default to Theme', and hunting neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the nightmoths, so Patient is the wrong role.

gaps_confirmed: A time adjunct on a measured value ('was seven at the third watch'): Measure has no time slot, tense only wraps it, and the copular-with-time-modifier reification is defined for adjectival property states, so no licensed carrier joins a value to when it held.
A day-index within a year ('on day 0 of Year 1'): (Day <n>) is the day-of-month slot, and an ordinal day-of-year calendar has no defined term.
A passage-initial date frame ('On day 0 of Year 1, ...'): nothing states whether it scopes over the following sentences, so only the first clause ends up dated.
new_gaps: A place restrictor on a measured quantity ('the moth-count AT the East Row'): LocatedIn is containment for positioned things and a count is not positioned, so the only carrier is folding the place into the Measure's bearer slot, which conflates 'the count at a place' with a measure of the place itself.

A universal distributed over a measured value ('the moth-count at EACH lantern ... was about twenty-five'): the distribution rule is specified with an event or property-atom conclusion, and QuantifierPhrase's second slot is a verb lemma or property — neither is defined for a Measure-conclusion rule.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form drops sk_moth_count_1 entirely and lets the clause ride the flat (Past (Measure east_row moth_count 7 unspecified)) — no role, Time or Past on a count witness. Issue 1: NO compliant form is licensed for 'seven at the third watch' — Measure has no time slot and tense only wraps it — so the compliant parse emits the untimed measure and records the loss as a gap. Issue 3: (Theme sk_hunt_1 sk_preymoths_1).
adjudication.notes: Everything outside the S7 block follows the instruction set closely — the counted sky-cat group plus per-member rule, the Cliff Path / East Row / Hollows name handling, and the 'each nightmoth that survived' relative-clause universal are all correct. The S2 clause shows the licensed shape the S7 clause should have reused.
